variants.label: Short floating prompt (custom)
variants.prompt:
Floating e-commerce product photo of this garment. Exact item from the reference, suspended in empty space with no wearer and no stand.

1) Through the neckline/hood opening show the garment's own back lining only — no white plastic tube, stump, head, or filler.
2) Natural three-dimensional retail shape; soft fabric hang; not flat or crumpled; do not puff or balloon the silhouette.
3) Arms hang straight down at the sides.
4) Pure white #ffffff background edge-to-edge.
5) No shadows of any kind.
6) Straight-on camera (0° yaw), centered, fully in frame.

Single item only. No props, hangers, or text.
